'''Plasteelworks''' were factories that were used to produce [[Plastoid/Legends|plastoid]] technology. During the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Republic Dark Age|Dark Age]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darkknell/Legends|Darkknell's]] capital city [[Xakrea]] had a plasteelworks factory.
